purpose: Determine whether Dk104 and Dk88 failures originate in the Ascend GDN prefill/decode numerical path before further parameter sweeps.

resource_contract.reason: A single NPU reproduces one TP4 worker's local tensor shapes without occupying the other three allowed cards.

gates.shape_defect: Dk128 and Dk64 pass while Dk104 or Dk88 fails.
gates.escalation_if_all_pass: Test packed projection, causal convolution, rearrange, GDN and cache using layer-real tensors.

claim_boundaries: This is numerical correctness evidence, not performance evidence.
One physical NPU reproduces TP4-local shapes but does not prove TP4 end-to-end behavior.
Existing Dk104 and Dk88 LongBench scores remain operational failures and are not algorithm-trend evidence until this gate is resolved.
